text:
Alex Chen: quick sync — planning per-customer toggle for the new enterprise perf profile. proposal: store allowlists in FF service, gate by account_id at request middleware, and surface contract-gating via Entitlements service. rolling canary to 5% of enterprise accounts first. thoughts?

Maya Patel: +1 on middleware check. one catch: cache TTL for flags needs to be low for enterprise (e.g., 30s) or we risk contract changes not taking effect. also suggest pub/sub invalidation when we flip an allowlist.

Todd Green: re: storage — feature-flag-service already supports "targeting" with arrays, but we should avoid giant arrays for customers >10k. for large allowlists, use a scoped tag (e.g., billing_plan: enterprise-v2) and a reverse lookup in Entitlements. keep allowlist arrays for VIPs only.

Sophia Rivas: to be clear, product wants three gates: (1) explicit allowlist for contracted VIPs, (2) contract-based gate (dedicated customers), (3) time-windowed canary. each needs audit trail for compliance. can legal/finance provide mapping of contract ids -> account ids?

Ben Morales: QA checklist draft: create 3 synthetic enterprise accounts (vip, contract-bound, control). tests: unit for middleware, integration with Entitlements mock, e2e with staging routing. also add perf regression test to ensure token latency impact <+20ms.

Alex Chen: here's a quick config example for ops/devs:

```
featureFlags.set('enterprise_perf_v2', {
  allowlist: ['acct_1001', 'acct_4520'], // VIPs
  contractGate: ['contract:dedicated_gpu'],
  canaryPercent: 5,
  cacheTTLSeconds: 30,
  emergencyDisableKey: 'flags.emergency.disable.enterprise_perf_v2'
})
```

Maya Patel: also: add a server-side telemetry tag "flag.variant=enterprise_perf_v2" and emit when fallback happens. we should alert if fallback rate >0.5% over 5m.

Todd Green: ops guardrail: add runtime kill switch in config service + infra-level firewall to block outbound if errors cascade. deploy pipeline should include a rollout step that expands account targeting by label, not raw list.

Sophia Rivas: product ask: make rollout scoped by customer tier in console so AMs can opt-in customers (self-serve). need UI hooks. also add note about contract audit events.

Ben Morales: test automation: qa_bot can create accounts and run smoke scenarios. can we get a staging entitlement sync job so Entitlements mirrors prod mapping daily?

QA Bot: scheduled: smoke-suite enterprise_flags -> running in staging. will post results here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

DeployBot: deployment queued for feature/enterprise-perf-toggle -> staging at 2025-09-24T15:20Z. CI: passed.

Alex Chen: action items I have: 1) Todd to add targeting support + emergency key (PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ff/+/4321) 2) Maya to implement pub/sub invalidation + telemetry 3) Ben to author test matrix and add synthetic accounts 4) Sophia to collect contract->account mapping from finance. i'll own rollout doc + canary runbook.

Todd Green: looking at PR now, tagging @Maya for review. will add feature flag metrics and prometheus exporter.

Maya Patel: noted. will add cache TTL config and invalidation hook to the SDK.

Sophia Rivas: finance, pinged in separate thread to get contract export. planning stakeholder walk-through next Tue.

Ben Morales: will draft test plans by EOD Friday.

Alex Chen: one more guardrail: if 503s or error-rate increase >0.5% in 10m, auto-disable for canary accounts and notify #incidents. can someone add that to Alerting?

Todd Green: I can add alert rules and a small lambda to flip emergency key. will push config to ops repo.

Alex Chen: thanks all. will publish rollout playbook once PR merges. :thumbsup:
